title: Fluent 2 official component source supplement (targeted R12 follow-up)
scope: Only the three open Fluent 2 fields in the integrated ledger: button/input heights, form Field spacing, and table density. This is not an exhaustive review of all Fluent 2 documentation, platforms, components, or product application.
method: Opened official Fluent 2 Web React component guidance and fetched Microsoft/fluentui implementation files from a commit-pinned GitHub raw URL. Current official pages were checked for stated numeric values; where absent, numeric values are derived only from pinned React code if the rule identifies that derivation. No value was borrowed from iOS, Android, Windows, or another platform.

button-code.title: Fluent UI React Button styles
button-code.findings: Button root declares vertical padding and typography, not a fixed height. Size-specific style also changes padding and type styles; small/medium/large natural box heights are derived from line-height plus vertical padding and 1px borders. Small/large icon variants use distinct vertical padding.

source_lines.details: Button base box sizing/border/medium vertical padding/line-height at lines 25-27, 63, 69; small size and icon padding at 290-303; large size and icon padding at 304-319.

input-code.title: Fluent UI React Input styles
input-code.findings: Input fieldHeights explicitly declares small/medium/large min-heights 24/32/40px; medium is the default. CSS unit is px.

source_lines.details: Root default min-height at 52-54; small/large variants at 118-129.

field-code.title: Fluent UI React Field styles
field-code.findings: Vertical label margin-bottom uses spacingVerticalXXS, large vertical labels use spacingVerticalXS; secondary helper/validation text margin-top uses spacingVerticalXXS. There is no parent/inter-Field spacing rule in this component file.

source_lines.details: Vertical/large label margins at 48-58; secondary text top margin at 80-83.

table-cell-code.title: Fluent UI React TableCell styles
table-cell-code.findings: Native table-cell height declarations: medium 44px, small 34px, extra-small 24px. Div/flex mode uses corresponding min-height. Cell horizontal padding is spacingHorizontalS; no universal row height beyond the size-dependent cell rule is asserted.

source_lines.details: Native cell heights at 18-30; flex min-heights at 36-51.

spacing-code.title: Fluent UI React global spacing token definitions

source_lines.details: Token scale values at 5-16; horizontal aliases at 19-31; vertical aliases at 34-46.

spacing-code.findings: The pinned token source maps XXS=2px, XS=4px, and S=8px to spacingVerticalXXS/XS and spacingHorizontalS respectively.

entries.field: Button and Input height by size (Web React)

values.button: React Button has no explicit fixed height. From the pinned CSS and existing Fluent type-token scale: small without icon = 16px line-height + 2×3px vertical padding + 2×1px border = 24px; medium/default = 20 + 2×5 + 2 = 32px; large without icon = 22 + 2×8 + 2 = 40px. Small-with-icon = 20px; large-with-icon = 38px. These are derived natural CSS box heights, not a height token or documented universal contract.
values.input: Input min-height small/medium/large = 24/32/40px; medium is default.

entries.conditions: Web React / Fluent UI React v9 implementation only. Button arithmetic assumes pinned styles, normal content line box, 1px border, and no consumer style overrides; line heights are existing Fluent type-token values (small 16px, medium 20px, large 22px). Icon variants alter vertical padding. Input values are min-height and content may require more height. The public component pages themselves state no numeric heights. The line-height inputs are cross-checked against the Fluent Web typography page (Caption1 16px, Body1 20px, Subtitle2 22px); no native platform type scale is substituted.
entries.units: CSS px; button values are derived px, Input values are declared min-height px.
entries.kit_comparison: Kit controls use min-height/control values 40/44/48px (src/spacing.mjs:7; src/styles/chunks.mjs:86,90). Values are not a one-to-one match with Fluent size variants. This is recorded as partial source-scope alignment; no product defect is asserted.

entries.field: Vertical Field label/helper spacing and inter-Field gap
entries.status: partially specified; general inter-Field gap not stated

values.vertical-label-to-control: Default vertical label margin-bottom = 2px (spacingVerticalXXS); large vertical label margin-bottom = 4px (spacingVerticalXS).
values.between-separate-fields: No general numeric gap stated in checked guidance/implementation; no value asserted.

entries.conditions: Web React Field component at the pinned Fluent UI React v9 commit; spacing aliases resolve to the pinned global token values (XXS 2px, XS 4px). The component file does not establish an enclosing form layout or sibling spacing.
entries.units: CSS px, expanded from pinned Fluent spacing tokens; inter-Field gap: not stated in checked paths.
entries.kit_comparison: Kit form fields use an 8px label/control gap and 20px field-group gap by default (src/styles/chunks.mjs:89). Fluent’s local label margin is token-based, while a general sibling gap is not stated; this is scope-limited and not a defect assertion.

entries.conditions: Web React Table size context (default medium); values are CSS cell height declarations, not a guaranteed final row height when content needs more space. The checked implementation has no separate row padding/density token; horizontal cell padding is a spacing token and is not translated here. The pinned global token source resolves spacingHorizontalS to 8px.
entries.units: CSS px for cell height/min-height and horizontal padding (8px per side); no vertical padding value asserted.
entries.kit_comparison: Kit table cells use 16px padding on desktop and 12px at the mobile breakpoint; row height is content-derived (src/styles/chunks.mjs:82-83). The sizing and padding contracts differ; this is a partial comparison, not an automatic product defect.

limits: The component guidance pages do not state numeric button/Input heights; button heights are an explicitly marked implementation-based CSS derivation.
Field guidance and the pinned Field component do not define a general gap between separate Field components. Token numeric expansion was not asserted.
Table cell height declarations can expand for content; they are not a promise of fixed rendered row height.
No all-platform equivalence, all-document coverage, or kit defect is inferred.
